'''Jeff Davis''' won the [[1997 Alderaan Regionals (Mountain View)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He was a member of Dark Force Rising, a team with [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Jeff Field]] and [[Dan Hammond]], listed on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="rising">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/rising.html Dark Force Rising], Paul Todd Feldman. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991022071037/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/rising.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I'm 24 yrs. old and happily married to my beautiful wife Laura."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/davis.html Jeff Davis], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427163836/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/davis.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I graduated from Cypress College of Mortuary Science (in Cypress, CA) in 1994 and became a licensed embalmer in 1995."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I've played Star Wars CCG ever since it hit the stores."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I love going to the movies and playing strategy type computer games."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I also am a huge baseball fan and enjoy taking Laura to San Francisco Giants games."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite Star Wars CCG card has got to be Zuckuss."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"He is the Dark Side Luke."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"He can go anywhere and draw destiny!"<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I also like him because he eventually joins the rebellion. (Rebel Scum!) My favorite Star Wars character is Salacious Crumb,."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"and my favorite line Star Wars is 'In time you will call me master!!"<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I would love to have that written on my forehead while playing in the World Championship!!!"<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'm a really easy going person who'll fit right into the atmosphere of the Finals."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I intend to have a really great time."<ref name="dec97bio" />
